item.text: {"text":"Recent work supports separating temporal dependence from perturbation artifacts. [Betello et al., ECIR 2024](https://arxiv.org/abs/2307.13165) examine sensitivity to interaction removal; [Cascade-guided Adversarial Training, SDM 2024](https://epubs.siam.org/doi/abs/10.1137/1.9781611978032.85) identifies temporal overreliance and cascading training effects as vulnerabilities. Neither establishes that sensitivity means recent behavior is spurious. [Disentangling User and Item Sequence Patterns, 2025](https://researchportal.helsinki.fi/en/publications/disentangling-user-and-item-sequence-patterns-in-sequential-recom/) compares random and constrained shuffling, motivating controls for temporal structure. These studies provide related evidence, rather than a validated intervention preserving all requested history properties.\n\nA proposed diagnostic adaptation: freeze the trained NextItNet and compare paired histories with identical left padding, length, final item and item multiset; perturb only earlier order using timestamp-local, lexically coherent swaps. This preserves item frequencies exactly, while coherence requires explicit checks. Assess empirical support through training-history transition counts, timestamp-gap distributions and title/description similarity; report rejection rates and matched-user coverage. Include identical-history controls and matched-magnitude older-versus-recent swaps; measure score, rank and validation-hit changes separately. These are proposed checks, not established guarantees. [Conditional permutation tests](https://academic.oup.com/jrsssb/article/82/1/175/7056014) and [conditional randomization tests](https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC10323874/) offer a statistical framework, but valid inference depends on the conditional resampling distribution being correct or sufficiently accurate. Handcrafted constrained swaps alone do not justify calibrated p-values. Results should describe model dependence under supported perturbations, with uncertainty across users; they cannot establish causal interest decay or future generalization."}
